task.title: Add canonical lexicon enforcement linter
task.summary: Add deterministic lexicon enforcement so user-facing docs, command help, tool schemas, skills, and validation reports use active canonical vocabulary and reject unused terms except explicit compatibility aliases.

goal.outcome: The canonical pruned lexicon is enforceable and unused quality/surface terms cannot re-enter user docs or agent guidance without explicit compatibility metadata.
acceptance: A lexicon linter reads active canonical terms, legacy compatibility aliases, and banned/removed terms from `.codewiki/kb/lexicon.md` or source-owned config.
The linter flags user-facing docs, command help, tool labels/descriptions, skills, generated views, and validation reports that use removed terms such as audit/proof/checks as canonical vocabulary.
Compatibility contexts for legacy source fields, file paths, current command aliases, and migration docs are explicit and narrow.
Linter output uses gateway/gate/linter/test/validation/evidence terminology in new messages where feasible while preserving backward-compatible profile names if required by source.
Tests cover allowed compatibility usage, rejected user-facing usage, and lexicon drift caused by adding unused terms.
non_goals: Do not rename every legacy source file or JSON schema field in this task unless needed for linter enforcement.
Do not delete compatibility aliases before the six-tool and command migrations land.
Do not make lexicon enforcement rely on generated graph output only.
Do not block documentation that explicitly describes a migration alias with approved rationale.
verification: wiki_gate/task-close linters for source-contract, stale-reference, changed, and horizontal-alignment

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

closure_brief.user_intent: Add deterministic canonical lexicon enforcement and make lexicon alignment part of decision/KB semantics.
implemented_changes: Implemented lexicon linter profile backed by .codewiki/kb/lexicon.md.
Documented temporary compatibility terms with replacement, allowed contexts, and deletion triggers.
Added decision-loop lexicon guardrail for project-specific technical vocabulary.
Updated adapter/README/skill wording toward linter/evidence vocabulary while preserving compatibility names.
Added smoke coverage and package smoke inclusion.

Did not rely on generated graph output only for lexicon enforcement.
remaining_risks: Historical KB/generated-view vocabulary drift remains visible under a full lexicon scan and should be handled by future migration work or scoped validation.

risks: Pi runtime tool schema in the current agent process may not expose the new lexicon profile until extension reload; source and tests include it.
